qwen3.title: Cross-Domain Independent Gear Discovery and Isomorphism Audit

isomorphism_audit.boundary: Exact shared gear keys across domains are strong isomorphism evidence. Shared layers without shared channels are only weak shape evidence.

qwen3.boundary: This phase independently discovers domain-local MLP gear candidates through class-vs-object readout support and validates them by zero/flip interventions. It is an atlas discovery/isomorphism audit, not language encoding closure.
